name: Firebase
label: Firebase — Firestore REST v1
description: Firebase — Firestore REST v1. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Official API: https://firebase.google.com/docs/firestore/reference/rest. Customer owns the database. Minimize payload. Secrets never logged or returned.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put oauth_access_token here. Example: {"operation":"firestore.document.get"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config. EXACT: firestore.document.get | firestore.document.create | firestore.document.delete | firestore.document.list | trigger.listen.

schema.label: projectId
schema.description: GCP project id in the documents path. Same shortCode as config. Example: my-project.

schema.label: databaseId
schema.description: Firestore database id. Default (default). Same shortCode as config.

schema.label: documentId
schema.description: Client-assigned document id query for firestore.document.create, and path id for get/delete. Optional on create (Firestore generates one). Example: user_123.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Firestore Document.fields map for firestore.document.create. Each key is a field name; each value is a Firestore Value object (stringValue, integerValue, booleanValue, timestampValue, mapValue, arrayValue, nullValue, doubleValue, bytesValue, referenceValue, geoPointValue). Example: {"name":{"stringValue":"Ada"},"age":{"integerValue":"36"}}. Official name; not a generic blob.

schema.label: mask
schema.description: DocumentMask fieldPaths for create/get, comma-separated. Query name mask.fieldPaths is not used; send a JSON object {"fieldPaths":["name"]} or a comma list name,age. Example: name,age. Omit to return all fields.

schema.label: orderBy
schema.description: Order-by field for firestore.document.list. Example: name. Official query orderBy.

schema.label: readTime
schema.description: RFC3339 read timestamp for firestore.document.list. Example: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

schema.label: showMissing
schema.description: When true, list returns missing documents with a key but no fields. firestore.document.list only.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON body. Secrets never copied here.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: firestore.document.get | firestore.document.create | firestore.document.delete | firestore.document.list | trigger.listen.

configurationParameters.label: Oauth Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Google OAuth access token (secret). Bearer. Never a host path to a service-account file.

configurationParameters.label: projectId
configurationParameters.description: GCP project id used when INPUT projectId is empty.

configurationParameters.label: databaseId
configurationParameters.description: Firestore database id used when INPUT databaseId is empty. Example: (default).
